card.name: Small words before 'the' in place phrases
card.fires_on: Short linking words (of, from, to, in, around) that come right before 'the' and a big place or event noun, such as the ocean, the border, the trenches, battle or the world, in general web prose.

modes.label: Side of the
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'this side' before a place like the ocean or the border.
modes.example: survival rates are better on this side<< of>> the border.

modes.label: Link before war or event noun
modes.description: A preposition after a verb or noun, ahead of 'the' plus a war, fire or contest term.
modes.example: the new naval technology hadn't been tried<< in>> battle until now.
